__meta: Shared Grafana template variables injected into every composed dashboard by assemble-dashboards.ps1. Keeps panels portable: any panel that references ${ds}/${prom}/${law}/${e2e}/${ns}/${org} drops into any dashboard because these variables always exist.

list.name: e2e
list.label: e2e.call_id
list.description: Canonical end-to-end call id. Leave blank for fleet views; set to trace a single call.

list.name: ns
list.label: Kubernetes namespace
list.description: Namespace/regex for cAdvisor resource panels. Blank matches all.

list.name: org
list.label: Organization / workstream
list.description: Optional filter carried on telemetry as d365.workstream / call.tenant. Blank matches all.
